profile.legalName: Rose Foundation For Communities And The Environment
profile.summary: A nonprofit based in Oakland, California, that supports environmental justice and community health. It directs funds from legal settlements and grants to community groups, funds small grassroots and consumer rights organizations, and runs a youth leadership program called New Voices Are Rising.
